questions.question: King Herod put John the Baptist in prison. What had John been telling him?

answers.text: Herod had no right to marry Herodias
Herod had no right to rule Galilee
Herod had no right to tax the temple

questions.question: Herodias, the wife of King Herod, wanted John the Baptist dead but could not make it happen. What stopped her?

answers.text: Herod feared John and protected him
The prison guards refused her orders

questions.question: At his birthday banquet, King Herod was pleased when a girl danced for him. What did he swear to give her?

answers.text: Whatever she asked up to half his kingdom
A palace of her own anywhere in Galilee
Gold and jewels from the royal treasury

questions.question: A girl asked King Herod for the head of John the Baptist. Why did Herod not refuse her?

answers.text: Because of his oaths and his guests
Because he feared what Herodias would do
Because John had insulted the girl
